Aligning with the uncropped master peach_E20267O_S2_a2.png confirms it: the c-crop is exactly a2[y87:1664, x0:1262] (correlation 1.00), and in a2 this bulge is the chin, directly below the lower lip.

LIP SLIVER: ~5-7 px of the lower lip remain on the right edge at ~x1255-1262, y953-1013 (darker, ~RGB 158-180/105-121/69-93, vs skin ~190/130/88). The eye and lashes clear the edge by only ~10 px and the brow by ~18 px.
notes: The hoop itself is faithful: a thick interlaced braid of multi-wire gold strands in polished yellow gold, no stones, and one flat disc just under the latch end. Closure is a thin hinged wire with the hinge knuckle at the other end, with no bail, T-bar or ball pin. One hoop in frame, which is allowed for S2.

Scale is OK. The ear is ~534 px tall (60mm, so ~8.9 px/mm). The hoop's outside is ~263x257 px (x720-983, y720-977), about 29-30mm, ~17% over 25mm and within tolerance. That matches the listing's own worn photo 3.jpg, where the hoop is ~0.5x the ear height.

Disc finish is borderline. In the lobe's shadow the disc reads satin or caramel (core ~RGB 170,111,63, no specular), while the braid beside it carries bright speculars (p90 L~195). The listing disc is bright mirror-polished (~249,217,163). At phone size it still reads as a flat gold disc.
The hinged wire runs horizontally through the lobe, ~6-7mm above its lower edge, with the hoop fully face-on in a lateral ear view. This is the usual catalogue look, worn on the lobe where it sits.

Camp colour is weak. The frame is ~48% black hair and ~44% skin and gold, with only ~8% peach wall at the bottom right (L75 C31 h62); the crop removed the peach blouse. It still reads warm, so it is not a fail on its own.
No text, logos, extra jewellery or hands.
fix: Re-shoot with the right edge of the frame at the jaw angle or back of the cheek, so no chin, lip, nose, eye or brow can enter.
